text: Redis is an in-memory data store commonly used for caching. Redis TTL defines how long a key remains available before it expires.
JWT is a token-based authentication mechanism. JWT expiration defines how long the authentication token remains valid.
SVC-57 is a Not_Found error returned when the requested resource does not exist. The API should return HTTP 404.
Spring Security provides authentication and authorization functionality for Spring Boot applications.
PostgreSQL indexes improve query performance by allowing the database to locate rows efficiently.
Redis distributed locking can coordinate access to shared resources across application instances.
Payment services should validate webhook signatures before processing payment events.
HTTP 401 indicates authentication is required. HTTP 403 indicates the user is authenticated but does not have permission.
Kafka is a distributed event streaming platform commonly used for asynchronous communication between microservices.
RabbitMQ is a message broker commonly used for asynchronous communication. Queues store messages until consumers process them.
